title: Moroccan Bissara Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Morocco, made with a variety of ingredients, including bissara. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the bissara, vine leaves, Moroccan spices, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Add the kissed tomatoes to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
